home.title: Order anything, from anywhere
home.subtitle: Food, groceries, gifts, parcels and more, delivered across Dharan, Itahari and Biratnagar.
home.step1Body: Pick items or fill a short form.
home.step2Body: Your order is written for you. Just press send.
home.step3Body: We confirm the delivery charge, then a rider brings it. Pay cash or QR at the door.
home.closedNow: We are closed right now. You can still browse and order when we open (10am – 10pm).

about.title: About Chitto Mitho
about.story: Chitto Mitho is your everyday delivery partner in Dharan, Nepal, since 2024. We bring food from your favourite cafés and restaurants, groceries, drinks, gifts and flowers, and parcels. If you need something from anywhere, just ask.
about.areas: We deliver in Dharan and nearby areas in every direction, including Itahari and Biratnagar.
about.pay: Cash on delivery or QR at the door (eSewa, Khalti, Fonepay). We confirm the delivery charge on WhatsApp before we deliver.

footer.area: Dharan, Nepal · delivering to Itahari, Biratnagar and nearby areas

delivery.note: Delivery charge will be confirmed on WhatsApp.

order.sentBody: Press send in WhatsApp. You can also share your live location there so the rider finds you easily.
